title: Native TDB factory creator registration static disassembly
question: Are host-owned stream creators registered via an actual match-name keyed TDB factory and called by BEE layer registration, and is native vector CanStore based on name prefixes?

environment.binary_versions: AE2025/AE2026 BEE.dll and TDB.dll pinned SHA256

procedure: Run ShapeLayerAE/tools/audit_tdb_factory.py on the two TDB.dll binaries
Decode BEE VectorStreamGroup CanStore via trace_vector_canstore.py and decode_canstore_constants.py
Interpret named exported functions and direct callsites only; do not invoke private APIs
conclusion: Confirmed host-internal matchname/creator factory registration chain and static native Shape predicate strings across both binary versions. External plug-in registration and edit/render parity remain untested.
limitations: Offline x64 scans do not reveal complete types, callback lifetime or ownership
RIP string recognition does not prove CanAdd semantics for unknown names

hypotheses.prediction: BEE Layer register routine calls TDB Factory registration wrapper
hypotheses.falsified_by: Reproducible exact-binary disassembly fails to resolve these IAT calls

hypotheses.prediction: An unknown prefix-matching native Shape child may pass structural CanStore
hypotheses.falsified_by: Read-only host CanAdd returns false for all controlled unknown prefixes
